name: Camp Mowglis
description_short: Overnight summer camp for boys on Newfound Lake in Hebron, NH, with traditional outdoor activities such as swimming, hiking, climbing, crew and archery. About 100 campers, one counselor for every three campers, and campers sleep in screened open-air dormitories grouped by age.
swim_waterfront_notes: Camp is beside Newfound Lake. Swimming and crew are listed as activities. The page gives no details on swim instruction or waterfront supervision.

warnings: This is an SEO/marketing page on the camp's own site. The main text still says 'Sign up for our 2021 overnight camping session today', which is outdated. The 2027 dates and prices come from a rates table embedded in the page.
Banner says 'Camp is live!' even though today is October 2026. This text is out of date.
Yearling ages don't match: the rates table says 15-17, but the menu says 'Yearling Program: Ages 15-16' and 'Outdoor Leadership Camp for Boys 15-16'.
Yearling/Junior Staff (7 weeks) is listed at $8,100, the same as the 3-Week Cub Program. Check this with the camp.
Prices are labeled 'Full Freight'. Other rates may exist.
